verdict.rationale: Fastmail's own help center has 'Import your mail' and 'Move from Gmail' articles. Community switchers corroborate a built-in migration tool and Gmail migrator that 'works great'. The pack only shows article titles, though, with no detail on import scope, and nothing documents contact import. missing for 10: documented contacts import, detail confirming complete mail-history import (all folders/labels, other providers and clients such as mbox or Outlook), in-depth first-party import documentation.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can import my complete mail history and contacts from my old provider or client

citations.quote: Fastmail has an easy migration tool if you don't want to go the IMAP route.
Gmail integration for ingesting mail and calendars works fantastically.
